description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cloth is hiring a Software Engineer to implement application features, maintain code, and debug software issues. The role also supports routine testing, readable code, and collaboration on test failures or release regressions.
Software Engineer implementing application features, maintaining behavior, writing unit tests, debugging errors, and supporting regression investigations

Responsibilities:
• Build defined application features in the selected programming language
• Create or revise unit tests for code you modify
• Modify application components while maintaining expected behavior
• Verify code changes locally before submitting them for testing
• Support investigation of test failures or release regressions
• Produce readable code that follows existing project conventions
• Inspect logs and debugging output to isolate software errors

Requirements:
• Experience through coursework, internships, or personal projects is acceptable
• Understanding of functions, data structures, and common debugging techniques
• Comfort reading API documentation and existing code
• Working ability in at least one programming language such as Python, JavaScript, Java, or C#
• Ability to write and interpret simple automated tests
